scoring_justification: Checker recomputes J and convex hull energies from raw total energies (total_energies.json) using the prescribed Heisenberg model formulas and composition decomposition, then compares recomputed values to paper-reported gold values within tolerances; also checks AFM ground state and ordering/threshold structural conditions.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold magnetic superexchange constants J (meV) and gold convex hull energies ΔE (kJ/mol); ordering and threshold conditions.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: main text and supplementary tables S1-S5 for J; Table 2 for ΔE. Values are the paper's reported primary nearest-neighbour superexchange constants and energy above convex hull.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numbers (LiAgF3-1: J=-77.74 meV, LiAgF3-2 J1=-358.75, J2=-10.54 meV, Li2AgF4-1 J=-62.46, Li2AgF4-2 J=-4.07, Li2AgF4-3 J=-95.48 meV; ΔE values: 10.1, 11.6, 8.1, 10.5, 18.1 kJ/mol).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own results; they serve as the authoritative reference for verifying reproduction.

outputs.description: Raw total energies from DFT+U calculations for all structures and spin configurations. The checker recomputes J and hull energies from this file.
Magnetic superexchange constants J. The checker compares these values (and their ordering) to hidden paper-reported references.
Energy above convex hull (ΔE). The checker compares these values to hidden paper-reported convex hull positions.

output_contract.notes: All energies are per formula unit. The checker will verify that all ternary structures have E_AFM < E_FM in total_energies.json, confirming the antiferromagnetic ground state.

steps.description: Checks that total energies exist, are properly structured, and that every ternary structure has E_AFM < E_FM (antiferromagnetic ground state).
Recomputes magnetic superexchange constants J from total_energies.json with Heisenberg model formulas and verifies against paper gold values, ordering, and threshold condition.
Recomputes energy above convex hull ΔE from total_energies.json and checks against paper gold values with tolerance.
